decisions.statement: A file a machine is set up with sits in akasha and is put in place from here.
Where a file goes is stated by the page rather than by the file's name.
A script that sets a machine up names the files that script places rather than holding those files.
A file placed by a link under the home is linked there by every landing.
A move of the folder such a file sits in is caught by the landing that moves it.
The scripts still have their table of files to place rather than reading the table from the pages.
A file placed with rights the landing has not is placed by the script alone.

definition: what a machine of Alan's is set up with before it can do work
